text: On the January 18th meeting of Civic Theatres Board, Item CT1.7 - Presentation on New Branding for Civic Theatres Toronto ( http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2019.CT1.7 ) was considered. I am requesting that this item be put on the agenda of the Executive Committee as a new business Item, as the new name of Civic Theatres has already been announced publically.

City Council on January 30 and 31, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council legally change the name of Civic Theatres Toronto to the name TO Live and amend Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 23, Civic Theatres accordingly.
